description: Les 12 caricatures : description, message, vocabulaire pour commenter un dessin de presse.

questions.question: Cartoon 1: Donald Trump speaks at the UN General Assembly with a little flower in his hand; the delegates look horrified (one imagines Munch's « The Scream »).
questions.verso: Message: the world's alarm and disbelief at Trump's « America First » speech at the UN (2018). La caricature montre la consternation des dirigeants du monde face au discours de Trump à l'ONU (2018).

questions.question: Cartoon 1 — Donald Trump speaks at the UN General Assembly with a little flower in his hand; the delegates look horrified (one imagines Munch's « The Scream »). What is the cartoonist's message?
choix: peacekeepers do not solve everything, but without them things would be even worse
the Security Council is unbalanced: the P5 dominate and the rest of the world is under-represented
the international community surrenders to Russia (annexation of Crimea, 2014)
the world's alarm and disbelief at Trump's « America First » speech at the UN (2018)
questions.explication: La caricature montre la consternation des dirigeants du monde face au discours de Trump à l'ONU (2018).

questions.question: Cartoon 2: « Time's up »: the Earth reads a « UN Climate Change Report » and sees Death with an hourglass, while Uncle Sam rides the planet waving « Making short-term profits from oil and coal ».
questions.verso: Message: the UN warns about climate change but the USA ignores it for short-term profits from fossil fuels. Opposition entre l'alerte climatique de l'ONU (rapport du GIEC 2018) et les profits à court terme des énergies fossiles.

questions.explication: Opposition entre l'alerte climatique de l'ONU (rapport du GIEC 2018) et les profits à court terme des énergies fossiles.

questions.question: Cartoon 3: A boat labelled « UN – Security Council » is sinking: huge animals (USA, UK, Russia, France, China) on one side, tiny crowds on the other. « I've TOLD them it's unbalanced! »
questions.verso: Message: the Security Council is unbalanced: the P5 dominate and the rest of the world is under-represented. Zapiro dénonce le déséquilibre du Conseil de sécurité dominé par les P5 → besoin de réforme.

questions.question: Cartoon 3 — A boat labelled « UN – Security Council » is sinking: huge animals (USA, UK, Russia, France, China) on one side, tiny crowds on the other. « I've TOLD them it's unbalanced! » What is the cartoonist's message?

questions.explication: Zapiro dénonce le déséquilibre du Conseil de sécurité dominé par les P5 → besoin de réforme.

questions.question: Cartoon 4: Bashar al-Assad shoots at the Syrian people; Vladimir Putin hands him a gun labelled « UN veto »: « Try this one… it's on the house. » (« Russia arms sales »)
questions.verso: Message: Russia uses its veto to protect the Syrian regime and sell it arms. Zapiro (2012) : le veto russe est une arme qui protège Assad.

questions.question: Cartoon 5: In front of UN headquarters, all the flags are white (surrender), except a Russian flag.
questions.verso: Message: the international community surrenders to Russia (annexation of Crimea, 2014). Peter Brookes (2014) : face à la Russie, l'ONU « agite le drapeau blanc ».

questions.question: Cartoon 6: Trump hits golf balls that smash the windows of the UN headquarters.
questions.verso: Message: Trump treats the UN with contempt and damages multilateralism. Mépris et attaques de Trump contre l'ONU (retraits, coupes budgétaires).

questions.question: Cartoon 7: A woman to a Blue Helmet: « Thank you. Thanks to you the situation is dramatic. » — « Without you, the situation would be tragic… »
questions.verso: Message: peacekeepers do not solve everything, but without them things would be even worse. Ironie : le maintien de la paix a des limites mais reste utile.

questions.question: Cartoon 8: « United Nations building directory »: feeble resolutions department, useless communiqués, gutless responses, chronic waffling, feeble excuses, mindless posturing, pathetic excuses… corpse identification department (9th floor).
questions.verso: Message: the UN only produces words and excuses and arrives too late, when there are only corpses left. Dénonciation de l'impuissance et de la bureaucratie de l'ONU.

questions.question: What does « gutless » mean (cartoon 8)?

questions.explication: to waffle = parler pour ne rien dire, tergiverser.

questions.question: What does « mindless posturing » mean (cartoon 8)?

questions.explication: posturing = poses, gesticulations.
